== Notes ==
* Divine Boon requires strong [[energy management]], since it increases skill costs and decreases natural regeneration.
* Unlike the Divine Favor bonus, [[Target#Untargeted_skills|untargeted skills]] will neither heal the caster, nor cause the energy loss.
* Divine Boon's healing ''always'' takes effect first, before the effects of the spell that triggered it. For example, its healing will occur before [[Zealous Benediction]] checks its target's health. When using [[Mend Condition]] to remove a [[Deep Wound]], Divine Boon's healing is still reduced by the Deep Wound.
